model.state_set: Append-only request and terminal-record stores satisfying the minimal Seed invariants
model.transition_relation: delta(store, operation) appends a valid request or record, evaluates without mutation, or rejects with unchanged store

profile_boundary: Policy evaluation, evidence acquisition, workflow, enforcement, federation, storage and cryptographic mechanisms are extension or implementation responsibilities.
rejection_obligation: A rejected operation MUST preserve the canonical store.
resolution_obligation: UNKNOWN is derived when no unique valid terminal record exists; only one valid locally authorized exact-binding ALLOW record permits the effect.
